Dungeons Deep Update - Chapter I
notes.content:
This patch paves the road for a three chapter main update, that could even be considered as an expansion of sorts. The first Chapter brings to us the Webveil Hollow instance, along lots of riches and some new materials and items. Some important notes towards those are the Ember Wand that shoots fireballs, three drafts that have various functions, one bringing home decorations for example, the other two enabling a foodstuff or a material. The foodstuff being called Cozonak, with a big replenish pool and the material is Noble Fabric that will be linked to future utilities in-game. This update has a divination action (

key ) tweak and two new achievements regarding the instance, along other fixes and tweaks. To be noted that Webveil Hollow is reeking with broodkins and their relatives but holds great treasures as the ones in the beginning of this post. On an ending note, please consider reviewing the game and letting me know more of your insights on the project's discord server. Also, if there are missing links in-game or bugs, I'll try to cover them ASAP. Enjoy!

notes.title: v1.10c3 Open Beta
notes.content:
Hey there!

This update brings:

* Few more bug-fixes;
* A revamp to equipped gear pieces giving stats, meaning:
Because of a framework's limitations that at a given time started duping equipped item's stats, I've decided to remove the named stats and upon equipping a gear item - such as boots, that were giving +5 STA - from now on the player will receive a Equipment Power point or more for each gear piece active on the character; Because the duping bug is still there and I don't want to allow possible inbalances in the gameplay, at a given time the Equipment Power will reach a capped 100 value.
- This 100 EP value is available to be converted to VIT/STA/WIS stats at the anvil.

Soon will come back with another batch of bug-fixes and might rest for a couple of days because as you can see all I do is to come with lots of updates for bugs I make solving bugs I make.

In an ending note, earlier today I've capped around 35 FPS in the editor. So somewhat progression regarding optimization was made, and the problem causing this was confirmed.

Take care and enjoy!
